items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: We even had the lighting set up. You know, because Carl Carruthers, who used to do the lights for Sammy Davis, Jr. and Count Basie, went there early and had pin, red and white lights.

ctx.x: We even had the lighting set up. You know, because Carl Carruthers, who used to do the lights for Sammy Davis, Jr. and Count Basie, went there early and had pin, red and white lights. He set the whole thing up, you know.
